column1: DATA EXTRACTION PLANNING & GOVERNANCE WORKBOOK — IDEA NO. 5 (PIT XXV IPD FK USU 2026)

column2: Extract and verify one study at a time carefully (starting with PDFs in Study Records) across Roster, assigned Strata (04-06), and RoB (07) before moving to the next study.
Reviewer 1 extracts full text with page/table anchors; Reviewer 2 independently verifies all counts, 95% CIs, and quotes. Senior reviewer arbitrates conflicts.
column5: Status: Not Started -> R1 -> R2 -> Finalized

column2: Never pool overlapping cohorts from the same hospital network: L1_Riyadh (S03/S04), L2_UNMC (S11/S20/S13), L3_VAPBRN (S33/S17), L4_Emory (S35/S50), L5_WashU_BJH (S41/S40), L6_OhioHealth (S19 supersedes PMC11779270).
Separate confirmed-ASB prescribing (Tab 04), diagnostic/UC/DOT/CAUTI & ITS slopes (Tab 05), and clinical safety/compensatory shifts (Tab 06). Zero cross-denominator pooling.
column5: Conditional Stratum A pooling only if >=3 comparable

column2: Extract raw integer Pre/Post ASB denominators (N) and antibiotic events (n) alongside reported aOR/RR. Spreadsheet formulas auto-compute Pre %, Post %, abs pp diff, and crude RR.
Capture exact EHR workflow trigger (BPA, mandatory indication menu, reflex UA->UC, hard-stop, EMR calculator, micro nudge) separately from education or audit-feedback co-interventions.
Route ITS studies to EPOC ITS (7 criteria), pre-post/DiD cohorts to ROBINS-I (D1–D7), and RCTs to RoB 2 (D1–D5); explicitly check COVID-19 and secular trend confounding.
Use standardized codes: NR (Not Reported), NA (Not Applicable), or Pending_PDF (32 paywalled/POW-gated articles). Keep mixed-age studies (S45–S48) strictly Sensitivity-Only.
